description: Use when planning a naval-air anti-surface strike involving aircraft survivability, attack-route selection, ammunition reserve, or surface-and-air target deconfliction.
Use when planning naval-air anti-surface strikes where aircraft exposure, ingress profile, pop-up timing, or return survival is a primary concern.
Use when planning anti-surface strike allocations where first-wave fire quantity competes with follow-up and re-attack reserve.
Use when selecting controlled fire quantities for red-force anti-surface attacks against targets with different defensive value and priority.
Use when choosing aircraft ingress altitude and approach profile for a naval-air anti-surface strike in contested air defense conditions.
Use when coordinating aircraft launch delay with surface-fire timing during a naval-air anti-surface operation.
Use when adjusting aircraft pop-up distance and attack range to balance target access, defensive exposure, and weapon employment opportunity.
Use when planning the sequence and delay of surface and air salvos against a defended naval target group.
Use when planning an anti-surface strike that must preserve aircraft recovery options and potential follow-up action after the initial attack.
Use when coordinating red surface combatants and carrier aircraft in one anti-surface strike plan against a defended blue naval group.
Use when surface ships and aircraft can unintentionally concentrate fire on the same blue-force target during a naval-air anti-surface strike.
